scope.description: P2 synthetic component foundation: block planning, independent indexed-BAM worker handles, logical retained-byte-bounded reorder sink and forced-out-of-order 1/2/4/24/40 determinism matrix. Production VCF/sidecar/FASTA handles, physical process-wide memory proof and full-data execution are excluded.

assumptions: Focal sites arrive in frozen dataset/VCF order and block planning never reorders them.
Every worker owns a separate BAM handle and index.
Synthetic worker-count parity is necessary but does not replace seven-dataset P7 evidence.

step_verify.step: Implement deterministic sample/contig/cost block planning with a clipped 5 kb halo.
step_verify.verify: Boundary tests cover 4096/4097 sites, 250000/250001 estimated alignments, contig transitions and coordinate clipping.

step_verify.step: Implement one independent HTSlib indexed BAM reader per worker.
step_verify.verify: Actual indexed synthetic BAM is fetched once per block and malformed/missing index paths return explicit ParseResult reasons.

step_verify.step: Implement a logical retained-byte-bounded ordered result sink with cancellation.
step_verify.verify: Every item above the deterministic per-item ceiling returns ITEM_TOO_LARGE regardless of sequence/completion order; charged buffered bytes stay within the configured logical cap and duplicate/late sequence IDs fail closed.

step_verify.step: Replay the same logical blocks at 1/2/4/24/40 workers.
step_verify.verify: Every run has an identical logical semantic SHA-256; worker_count>1 proves sequence 1 buffered before sequence 0; injected worker failure cancels the sink, returns no ordered batch and retains diagnostic staging without claiming production freeze.

deviations: The first TSan determinism replay identified a condition-variable double-lock report in the test-only worker activation barrier. The barrier was replaced by an atomic arrival gate and the race report disappeared.
TSan runtime helper threads make the production process-thread ceiling unobservable under instrumentation; the <=46 assertion remains active and passed in non-TSan Debug and Release builds.

Two read-only review subagents were spawned without child task records. They made no filesystem writes; root independently applied and verified their findings. This is recorded as a process deviation rather than backfilled with a false historical lease, and future delegation requires a child task record before spawn.

The first clean-commit AI readiness replay failed because the script treated an unrelated producer header newer than the intentionally independent governance executable as a stale governance build. The evidence was rejected, the dependency scope was repaired and a positive CTest regression was added before recapturing the audit.

The first evidence-binding patch matched P0's foundation-audit row and inserted the P2 report/audit under P0. Main-repo schema/state checks passed because the paths existed, but three scratch negative tests caught the missing copied report. The released task was resumed with a fresh lease, the bindings were moved to P2, and full integration was replayed before release.
